summary: [Sample response – sample mode is on, so this ignores what you typed.] Treat this as a data ownership problem first and a reporting problem second. Agree on the handful of numbers leadership relies on, fix where they come from, then build reports on top.
steps: Interview the five to eight people who use the reports most to find the numbers that matter.
Map which system each of those numbers comes from and where they conflict.
Agree on one definition per metric and a named owner for each.
Build a single reporting data store fed from the source systems.
Deliver a small set of leadership reports, then expand.
assumptions: Mid-sized company with a moderate budget
No hard deadline in the next three months
Leadership is willing to name data owners
